svg.title: Mineral processing operator — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as mineral processing operator, wearing coveralls and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A tapered feed hopper sits above two separate crushing rollers and a small lower product chute. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a hard hat.
